name: High Sorcerer Andromath
summary: High Sorcerer Andromath is a short summons directing Alliance mages to report to the summit of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind. High Sorcerer Andromath stands as one of the kingdom's preeminent archmages outside the ruined city of Dalaran.

sections.title: Summons to the Tower
sections.body: Within the Mage Quarter of Stormwind, apprentice coordinator Jennea Cannon directs promising casters upward to the peak of the Wizard's Sanctum. High Sorcerer Andromath, one of the most senior practitioners of the arcane operating actively in the southern kingdoms, specifically requests an audience with emerging magi ready for weightier responsibilities.

sections.title: A Master Outside Dalaran
sections.body: With the northern magocracy of Dalaran ruined in the Third War and its surviving wizards consumed by the work of rebuilding it, practitioners like Andromath hold vital strategic importance. Without easy access to the libraries of the Violet Citadel, the Alliance relies directly on senior archmages stationed within Stormwind to study ancient threats and direct research into shadowy, forbidden arts.

faq.answer: High Sorcerer Andromath is an esteemed senior mage residing at the very top of the Wizard's Sanctum in Stormwind. He is recognized by his peers as one of the most powerful and knowledgeable spellcasters active in the world outside Dalaran.

faq.q: Where can I find High Sorcerer Andromath?
faq.answer: He can be found at the apex of the Wizard's Sanctum, the spiraling tower located in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind.

faq.q: Why does Jennea Cannon send me to see him?
faq.answer: Jennea Cannon identifies promising casters who have outgrown basic instruction and sends them to Andromath for higher council and specialized, hazardous research tasks.

faq.q: What does Andromath need help with?
faq.answer: Andromath enlists capable mages to investigate dark arcane secrets, specifically sending them to retrieve a dangerous historical volume: Ur's Treatise on Shadow Magic.

faq.q: Why is Dalaran described as 'locked away'?
faq.answer: Jennea's phrase reflects how withdrawn the Kirin Tor have been since the Third War. After the Scourge and the Burning Legion devastated their city, Dalaran's surviving wizards turned inward to rebuild it, leaving few of them involved in outside affairs.

faq.q: Is this quest exclusive to mages?
faq.answer: Yes. This summons is part of the dedicated training and quest path for Alliance mages advancing their craft.

angles.text: This summons marks a transition from routine spellcraft exercises under Jennea Cannon to direct research into dangerous, specialized lore alongside one of Stormwind's premier archmages.
With Dalaran's surviving magi absorbed in rebuilding their ruined city, the Alliance depends heavily on Stormwind's own Sanctum to train mages and counter supernatural threats.
